notes.title: 《KunKun dream Startles the Soul》Unable to connect tomultiplayer,Troubleshooting
notes.content:
Unable to search for rooms, unable to join rooms, no response when pressing Start Dream, high latency during gameplay

You can try the following methods:

1. Ensure the host’s network is stable.
2. Restart your computer, restart Steam, and restart the game.
3. Ensure both the host’s and player’s Steam connections are working properly.
4. Use a VPN or accelerator to speed up Steam and ensure a stable connection.
5. You can directly invite friends via Steam to join the matchmaking lobby.
6. The game server uses Steam P2P mode. If the host lags, players will also experience lag. If the host.quits the game, the players will also be disconnected.
